notes.title: The DEMO's not polished enough yet for Fest June,
notes.notes: [p]Hi，[/p][p]We hit a snag with the code merge, and that really threw our schedule off. And with all the work that got pushed back for Children's Day, things got even more backed up. On top of that, this DEMO's still got a few bugs we're ironing out. So yeah, looks like we won't be able to get it out before the New Products Festival.[/p][p]But , we're not giving up. We're gonna put out a cool gameplay demo in a few days[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The good news is that after a few days of tweaking, the gameplay has now reached our expectations.[/p]

notes.title: I HATE Children’s Day
notes.notes:
I  HATE Children’s Day
THis June 1st was a nightmare. My place got overrun by 7 kids for ‘Children’s Day’—ended up playing babysitter for 48 hours straight. Zero work done, totally screwed my deadlines. Worst. Holiday. Ever.
I should've seen this coming, but I was so damn tired I totally blanked on their existence—until I heard those little voices screaming my name...

Pro tip: If you own multiple game consoles（like me ,I  got  WII, xbox360+kinect, Switch ,NDS, GBA,）, for the love of God, don't advertise it to kids. They'll grow into permanent house guests who'll raid your setup daily - zero regard for how busy you are.

I  will go to work tomorrow ,So tired,
I  am worry about  the next Fest,  can I  catch the day ?  I  am not sure now
